sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.3757/2025, first application filed under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of appellant-Tulshi alias Vikas.

This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 26/12/2024 passed in SC No.36/2023 by Special Judge (POCSO Act), District Shivpuri (M.P.) whereby present appellant has been convicted as under:
 Section Imprisonment   363 of IPC 2 Years' R.I. Rs.500  stipul  366 of IPC 3 Years' R.I. Rs.1,0  stipul  376(3) of IPC 20 Years' R.I. Rs.1,0  stipul  5L/6 20 Years' R.I. Rs.2,0  of POCSO Act stipul
It is the submission of counsel for appellant that the trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to present appellant.
He has already suffered around 15 months of incarceration as pre and post trial detention.

It is further submitted that prosecutrix was major which is reflected from the testimony of her mother (PW-5) when she says that her marriage solemnized 30 years back and prosecutrix is her third daughter and every sibling has 2-3 years of age gap.
From this angle, it appears that prosecutrix was around 19-20 years of age at the time of incident.

In her statement,
prosecutrix admits her relationship with appellant and it appears that both shared emotional and physical proximity with consent.
It is case of consent prima facie.
That apart, appellant has good case on merits and final hearing of appeal would take some time.
He undertakes to abide by all terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Under such circumstances, learned counsel for appellant prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to present appellant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its dismissal.
Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, this Court intends to allow the application for suspension of sentence (I.A.No.3757/2025).

If appellant-Tulshi alias Vikas furnishes bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 08/05/2025 and thereafter, on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Office for appearance, then he shall be released on bail and execution of jail sentence is suspended till disposal of this appeal, subject to deposit of fine amount.
Appellant shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant/victim side in any manner and he shall not move in their vicinity; otherwise, benefit of bail given today by way of suspension of sentence shall be withdrawn immediately.
I.A.No.3757/2025 stands disposed of, accordingly.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
(Anand Pathak) (H  Judge J  (Dubey)
